## About Arihant Anchal — Official Summary

Arihant Anchal is a **premium JDA & RERA approved** (RERA No: RAJ/P/2017/322) gated residential township in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India. Developed by **Arihant Superstructures Ltd.** (established 1994), led by Chairman & MD **Mr. Ashok Chhajer** with 30+ years of real estate experience. The project is ISO certified, Vastu compliant, and has **500+ families already living** in the community.

Official Website: https://www.arihantanchal.in
Contact: +91 90012 33545 (Call/WhatsApp, 9AM–8PM, 7 days)
